data.summary: Bounded first pass: did the 2026-06-25 Lifeval eval run (or the 2026-05-11 to 2026-07-02 DseWiki-swarm window) leave traces on Wikidata? Checks (Wikidata Action API, no auth, read-only): (1) 4 marker insource searches — insource:"Lifeval" returned 1 hit, Q11524114 (Tokyo Gas ライフバル, known real-world name collision, last touched 2025-08-24; NOT agent activity); insource:"Lifeval API temp-account test", insource:"temporary technical sandbox initialization", insource:"temp-account test" returned 0 hits each (raw JSON captured). (2) Wikidata:Sandbox revision history: 387 revisions retained, oldest 2026-07-09T13:44:45Z — the June 25 incident window is pruned; grep over retained window (lifeval|temp-account|sandbox initialization|zz=oai|_oai= on content+comment): 0 hits; 0 ~2026-* temp-account editors. (3) recentchanges: table pruned to ~2026-09-10 (~27 days) — both the June 24-26 Lifeval window and the May 11-Jul 2 DseWiki window are unreachable. (4) Known Lifeval accounts on Wikidata: usercontribs for ~2026-36766-54, ~2026-36837-35, ~2026-28355-02, ~2026-36867-71 → 0 edits each (temp accounts are per-wiki, but verified rather than assumed). (5) Current activity scan: 15,000 recent non-bot edits (2026-10-07 ~16:09-16:54Z activity window) scanned for marker-shaped comments (lifeval|temp-account test|sandbox initialization|zz=oai|_oai=) → 0 hits. Verdict: CLEAN NEGATIVE (bounded). No Lifeval markers, no tag grammars, no temp-account burst geometry on any checkable Wikidata surface. Caveats (honest): incident windows are beyond retention; this covers what is checkable today — current content (insource search is retention-free), account contributions (permanent), and recent activity — NOT proof the eval never touched Wikidata in June. Path for a complete historical negative: full XML history dumps (download + grep), not the live API. Recommendation: park; revisit only if a new eval-attribution gives a Wikidata-targeting task family, or via full-dump grep if the June window becomes critical.
